fileStatus.rejected: Refused: the file wasn't what it said it was

sections.contact: How FOA and people can reach you

name.label: Name
name.hint: Your organisation's name, or your own if you rescue or foster on your own. It becomes part of your page's address.
name.error: Enter a name of 2 to 120 characters.

description.label: What you do
description.hint: A few sentences about your work, for people looking for help. Up to 2,000 characters.
description.error: Write up to 2,000 characters about what you do.

address.label: Address
address.hint: FOA uses it to check who you are. It is never shown on your public page.
address.error: Enter your address, up to 300 characters.

pinCode.label: PIN code
pinCode.hint: Six digits. People will find you by distance from it.
pinCode.error: Enter a PIN code of six digits, not starting with 0.

contactPhone.label: Mobile number
contactPhone.hint: An Indian mobile number. FOA uses it to reach you.
contactPhone.error: Enter an Indian mobile number of 10 digits.

contactEmail.label: Email address (optional)
contactEmail.error: Enter an email address like name@example.com.

website.label: Website (optional)
website.error: Enter a web address like example.org.

publicContactFields.label: Contacts on your public page
publicContactFields.hint: People will see only what you tick. Your address never shows; your town, state and PIN code do.
publicContactFields.error: Add the email address or website you chose to show, or untick it.

alerts.invalid_input: Some answers need fixing. Each one says what to change.
alerts.already_registered: You already have a listing waiting or on the directory. You can register another once it is withdrawn or not accepted.
alerts.listing_not_editable: This listing can't be changed in its current status.
alerts.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a few minutes.

meta.title: List your organisation
meta.description: Join FOA's directory of animal-welfare organisations and rescuers.

register.title: List your organisation
register.lead: NGOs, rescue organisations, shelters, independent rescuers and foster caregivers can join FOA's directory. FOA checks every listing before it goes public.
register.next: After you send it, upload proof such as a registration certificate or an identity proof, so FOA can check your listing.

meta.title: Your directory listings
meta.description: The directory listings you look after.

mine.title: Your directory listings
mine.lead: Keep your listing up to date, send FOA proof, and see what FOA decided.
mine.registered: Thank you. Your listing is waiting for FOA to check it. Upload your proof below to help FOA decide.

forbidden.title: You can't open this listing
forbidden.body: Only the people who look after a listing can open it. If you think you should, contact FOA.

listing.saved: Saved. Your changes are on your public page.
listing.savedPending: Saved. FOA will see your changes when it checks your listing.
listing.resubmitted: Saved. Because the name or type changed, FOA checks your listing again before it goes back on the directory.
listing.withdrawnNotice: Withdrawn. Your listing is off the directory for good.
listing.uploaded: Uploaded. FOA will see it once its safety check is done.

documents.title: Proof for FOA
documents.lead: Only FOA staff can open these files. You see what you sent and whether it arrived safely.
documents.caption: Files sent to FOA
documents.limits: A PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 10 MB.
documents.closed: This listing can't take more files in its current status.

errors.type_not_allowed: Upload a PDF, JPEG or PNG.
errors.too_large: The file is over 10 MB. Upload a smaller one.
errors.listing_not_editable: This listing can't take more files in its current status.
errors.too_many_documents: This listing has as many files as it can hold. Contact FOA if you need to send more.
errors.upload_failed: The upload didn't finish. Check your connection and try again.
errors.forbidden: You can't upload files to this listing.
errors.not_found: The upload couldn't be found. Please try again.
errors.upload_missing: The upload didn't arrive. Please try again.
errors.size_mismatch: The file changed while uploading. Please try again.
errors.type_mismatch: The file isn't the type it said it was.
errors.upload_expired: The upload took too long. Please try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a few minutes.

withdraw.title: Withdraw this listing
withdraw.lead: Withdrawing takes your listing off the directory for good. To list again later, register again.

reason.label: Why (optional)
reason.hint: FOA sees this. Up to {max} characters.

errors.transition_not_allowed: This listing can't be withdrawn in its current status.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a few minutes.

meta.title: Change your listing
meta.description: Change what your directory listing says.

edit.title: Change {name}
edit.lead: Changes to the details show on your public page at once. A new name or type goes back to FOA for checking first.

public.noContact: This listing hasn't shared contact details. You can ask FOA to pass on a message.
public.disclaimer: FOA checks who a listing is before it appears here. FOA doesn't run this organisation and isn't responsible for its work. If something about it worries you, tell FOA.

notFound.title: No listing at this address
notFound.body: It may have moved off the directory.
